name: Shadow Chimp - Rebirthed
summary:
Shadow Chimp - Rebirthed is a VR horror experience that takes place inside of an old, abandoned facility that has seemingly been left untouched for years. The building is completely empty, silent, and decayed, with dark hallways, damaged rooms, flickering lights, and strange sounds echoing throughout the environment. Players take on the role of someone who mysteriously ends up trapped inside of the facility with little to no understanding of where they are or how they got there.
